partial.label: Thin cover (rule only; the ML has no partial class)

method.model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, class_weight='balanced', random_state=0); HistGradientBoostingClassifier(class_weight='balanced', random_state=0) for hgb_class
method.trained_on: labelled Sentinel-2 dates of the 150 m clusters in the 10 km box around car_colusa_rice, years 2016-2025; this field is never in training (clusters >= 150 m away)
method.observations: Sentinel-2 L2A only (field clear >= 0.5, >= 20 clear px); the models were trained on S2
method.smoothing: random forest: 3-observation centred mean of class probabilities; hgb/consensus: 3-observation mode
method.consensus: majority of rule / RF / HGB (rule 'partial' abstains); no majority -> highest mean RF+HGB probability
method.daily_fill: linear interpolation of smoothed probabilities between observations <= 30 days apart, argmax; longer gaps unknown
method.markers: ds transition logic on the smoothed RF classes: green_up = first of 3 covered after bare/water; senescence_harvest = first of 2 non-covered after cover; cutting = a drop with regrowth within 45 days on alfalfa/hay years
method.forward_years_note: years after the CDL labels end; nothing trained on them
method.credit: Labels, features, vote and transition logic: spuriNV (ds branch); multi-field sample and splits: backend/ai.
method.out_of_box_note: This field is 39.3 km from the centre of the training box around car_colusa_rice. The model was not trained on this area, so its calendar is a transfer test; read it next to the rule calendar.
